label: Run TLC program
args: root=$1; file=$2; if [ -x "$root/build/tlc" ]; then bin=$root/build/tlc; elif command -v tlc >/dev/null 2>&1; then bin=$(command -v tlc); else echo "tlc was not found. Build it with: cmake --build build --target tlc" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$bin" --run "$file"

label: Check TLC program
args: root=$1; file=$2; if [ -x "$root/build/tlc" ]; then bin=$root/build/tlc; elif command -v tlc >/dev/null 2>&1; then bin=$(command -v tlc); else echo "tlc was not found. Build it with: cmake --build build --target tlc" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$bin" --check "$file"

label: Build TLC debug binary
args: root=$1; file=$2; out=$3; if [ -x "$root/build/tlc" ]; then bin=$root/build/tlc; elif command -v tlc >/dev/null 2>&1; then bin=$(command -v tlc); else echo "tlc was not found. Build it with: cmake --build build --target tlc" >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"; exec "$bin" -g -o "$out" "$file"
